name: vm2api-quota
description: Type /quota to see the current account's 5h/7d usage plus per-account pool quotas and billing from a vm2api gateway. Executed locally — no model involvement, nothing enters the LLM context. Read-only GETs.

base_url.title: Gateway URL
base_url.description: vm2api gateway base URL. Optional — falls back to VM2API_BASE_URL / ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL / settings.json.

master_key.title: Master API key
master_key.description: The gateway master key (VM2API_API_KEY on the server). Unlocks per-account pool quotas and billing sections. Stored in secure storage. Optional.

panel_token.title: Panel session token
panel_token.description: Any /api/panel/* credential (console session token from POST /api/panel/login). Alternative to the master key. Stored in secure storage. Optional.
